continuity.narrative_arc: Prayer for strength; discipline, breath and concentration; vision of form and formless bliss; subtle ascent; liberation paths; final refuge.
continuity.palette_arc: Matte burnt sienna, ochre, deep maroon, cream and muted olive throughout; reserve deep indigo-blue for the Lord; let restrained cream light increase in the liberation scenes.
continuity.notes: One concept per stanza. Every portrait remains planned for independent composition after landscape review. Source photographs guide story only and may contain text or unrelated visual styles.
